name: TD Power Systems Ltd
about: TD Power Systems Ltd is engaged in manufacturing AC generators and Electric motors for various applications which are specifically designed to suit the needs of the customers based on their requirements and specifications.[1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
The company manufactures generators, catering to conventional and renewable fuel-based power plants. Its output capacities range from 1 MW to 200 MW for steam gas turbines, up to 35 MW for hydro, up to 20 MW for diesel, and gas engines, and customized ratings for wind turbines. [1]

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 55.6% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 12.4 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -31.7%
